format: Shell script / Makefile fragment (UCLIBC build scripts and configuration)
description: This file is a build and configuration script for uClibc, a small C library for embedded systems, used within a Yocto-based environment. It includes variable definitions, shell functions, and configuration steps to build, patch, and install uClibc, with numerous references to configuration files, build options, and external scripts.

methods.name: do_patch_append
methods.description: Applies symbolic link patches to include directories using subprocess calls.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures uClibc by merging configuration snippets and applying mangling rules.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built uClibc library and cleans up headers.

methods.name: do_install_append_pn-uclibc
methods.description: Builds and installs uClibc-specific utilities such as ldd and ldconfig.
